headline: Central Bank of Nigeria Reallocates Oil and Gas Export Terminals to Inspection Agents
summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria appointed eight pre-shipment inspection agents and two monitoring and evaluation companies, reallocating export terminals to strengthen oversight and transparency in petroleum export trade.
why: Regulatory and supervisory changes in crude export administration affect revenue collection, trade transparency, and compliance costs for operators in Nigeria's oil sector.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Stricter export inspection procedures affect compliance frameworks for oil exporters.
